name: blackhole_r5
description: R3->R8 on the sample topology. At step 2 the core router R5 becomes a blackhole: every link incident to R5 gets loss 0.99 and reliability 0.10. The initial AI path R3-R5-R7-R8 uses R5, so the recommender should reroute to the R4/R6 side. Metric-level simulation only.
